purpose: Evaluation labels from the 2026-11-04 shadow audit of the proposed flag-dependence routing rule (docs/agent3-plan.md). Assessed by reading saved runs, Agent 1 records and source text; not produced by any pipeline stage and never a model input or a production verdict.

definitions.AFFECTS: The disputed interpretation could change a displayed claim, action, severity, resolution or a decision-relevant omission.
definitions.INDEPENDENT: Saved evidence establishes what the flag disputes and shows the card's displayed conclusions do not depend on it.
definitions.UNKNOWN: The saved record is too coarse to decide.
definitions.PRESERVED: Not classified: a projection gap keeps its own routing rule.
